# Guaso Content — full integration prompt (llms-full)

## Product
Guaso Content = headless content plane. Owner edits via Guaso chat (WhatsApp/Telegram). Your Next/v0 app hosts UI and reads content via this SDK.

## Contract
- Package: `@guaso-ai/content` (public npm; monetization is Guaso capability + token, not the package)
- Runtime: **server-only** (RSC, Route Handlers, Node). Never import in `"use client"` or browser bundles.
- Auth: Bearer token (`gct_…`) from Guaso chat once at site create. Store in server env `GUASO_CONTENT_TOKEN`. Site id in `GUASO_SITE_ID`.
- Base URL: `https://api.guaso.link` (override with `baseUrl` / `GUASO_API_BASE` for staging).

## API
- `GET /api/v1/content/entries/{content_key}`
- `POST /api/v1/content/entries/batch` body `{ "keys": ["pages/home", ...] }`
- Response entry: `{ siteId, guasoVersion, key, contentType, data, empty }`
- Empty-clear: key absent → `data: null`, `empty: true`, status 200
- 401 invalid token; 429 rate limit; 503 if rate-limit backend unavailable (fail-closed)

## SDK
```ts
import { createClient } from "@guaso-ai/content";

export const content = createClient({
  siteId: process.env.GUASO_SITE_ID!,
  token: process.env.GUASO_CONTENT_TOKEN!,
  // baseUrl: process.env.GUASO_API_BASE,
});

const home = await content.getEntry("pages/home");
if (home.empty) {
  // render empty state — do not invent copy
} else {
  // home.data is the page object (may include blocks[])
}

const many = await content.getEntries(["pages/home", "pages/about"]);
```

## Schema / blocks
- `guasoVersion` in responses — evolve renderers forward-compat (unknown block type → ignore).
- Chat can **create** only Guaso catalog block types; custom keys are edit-only (cap 20).

## Revalidate
Optional webhook URL registered at site create (HTTPS, public IP). Guaso POSTs after publish:
`{ "secret", "tags": ["content"], "siteId"?, "guasoVersion"? }`.
Wire your host (Vercel/Netlify/…) to bust cache on that POST. Failures do not roll back Neon writes.

## Anti-patterns
- Putting token in `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` or client JS
- Expecting Neon connection string from Guaso
- Calling write HTTP endpoints (none exist)
- Generating freeform JSX as the content source of truth (use schema-bound data + your components)
